ExampleDefinition.Description:
A common use case demonstrates a [b]Racing Telemetry Dashboard[/b] built on top of synthetically generated single-lap data. These are used to visualize parameters such as RPM, Speed for each wheel, oil and exhaust temperature, throttle and braking usage, etc. It showcases how multiple telemetry signals can be visualized and correlated across different domains.
The [b]Racing Telemetry Dashboard[/b] combines a few techniques in SciChart WPF chart library to create a beautiful and easy to read(analyze) chart demonstration.
[b]User Interaction[/b]
- Y-axes in Distance and Time charts are synchronized using the [b]RangeSyncGroupId[/b] property. - X-axes are also synchronized across charts, enabling unified navigation in both distance and time domains. - Zooming in Distance and Time charts can be performed using the right mouse button. - Double-click (left mouse button) performs Zoom Extents. - A white vertical slice line is displayed on both Distance and Time charts. It is synchronized and can be moved by dragging. - The vertical slice performs hit-testing across all series at the selected position. - Hit-test results are displayed in the legend panel on the left, showing telemetry values at the selected point. - Bottom (Cross Domain) charts support interaction via left mouse button using RubberBandXyZoomModifier. - The legend panel on the left is scrollable via an integrated scrollbar.
